description: This file implements a stress testing framework for Zephyr RTOS, including timers, thread management, CPU load control, and reporting functions.

methods.name: test_timeout
methods.description: Handles test timeout by aborting the stress test.

methods.name: adjust_load
methods.description: Adjusts CPU load backoff times based on a ratio.

methods.name: progress_timeout
methods.description: Reports current progress of the stress test.

methods.name: control_load
methods.description: Monitors and adjusts CPU load to maintain desired levels.

methods.name: preempt_update
methods.description: Updates preemption counts for active threads.

methods.name: cont_check
methods.description: Checks whether a thread should continue based on preemption and execution counts.

methods.name: randomize_t
methods.description: Randomizes a timeout value to introduce variability.

methods.name: microdelay
methods.description: Performs a small delay with busy-waiting.

methods.name: ztress_timeout
methods.description: Handles stress thread timeout events, invoking thread handlers.

methods.name: sleep
methods.description: Sleeps for a randomized duration.

methods.name: ztress_thread
methods.description: Main function for stress test threads, executing handler loops.

methods.name: thread_cb
methods.description: Callback to retrieve thread IDs and names.

methods.name: ztress_init
methods.description: Initializes stress test context and timers.

methods.name: ztress_end
methods.description: Cleans up timers and resets thread priorities after test.

methods.name: active_cnt_init
methods.description: Initializes active thread count based on thread data.

methods.name: ztress_execute
methods.description: Starts a stress test with specified thread and timer data.

methods.name: ztress_abort
methods.description: Aborts ongoing stress test execution.

methods.name: ztress_set_timeout
methods.description: Sets the timeout duration for the stress test.

methods.name: ztress_report
methods.description: Prints a report of the stress test execution statistics.

methods.name: ztress_cpu_clock_to_sys_clock_check
methods.description: Checks if system clock is within acceptable range relative to CPU clock.
